question: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam received which of the following awards in the year 1998?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Bhushan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam:-**

 
 
• He was conferred with many titles and awards such as "Sangeet Peeth of Bombay", "Asthana Natyacharya of Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam",and many more.
 
• He was awarded by many state governmen
